credentials.description: API key generated from the Africa's Talking dashboard (a new key invalidates the old one)
application username — always "sandbox" in the sandbox; sent as the username form field, not as a header
`from` (optional): your registered short code or alphanumeric; defaults to AFRICASTKNG

example_prompt: Send an SMS to one or more phone numbers with Africa's Talking (sandbox supported).

username.description: Your Africa's Talking application username. Docs (Authentication): "When working with the sandbox(our dev environment), the username is always sandbox."

to.description: A comma separated string of recipients' phone numbers. The docs' samples use the international format with + (e.g. "+254711XXXYYY,+254733YYYZZZ").

message.description: The message to be sent. Avoid the % character (see gotchas).

from.description: Your registered short code or alphanumeric, defaults to AFRICASTKNG.

bulkSMSMode.description: Who gets billed for a message sent with a Mobile-Terminated ShortCode; default 1 (the Africa's Talking account). Ignored for alphanumerics and Mobile-Originated shortcodes. Docs: "The value must be set to 1 for bulk messages."

enqueue.description: 1 to queue the messages and send them asynchronously after responding (default 1), 0 to disable.

keyword.description: The keyword to be used for a premium service.

linkId.description: Used for premium services to send OnDemand messages: the linkId forwarded to your application when the user sends a message to your service.

retryDurationInHours.description: Number of hours your subscription message should be retried in case it's not delivered to the subscriber.

Message.description: Summary message (e.g. "Sent to 1/1 Total Cost: KES 0.8000").

statusCode.description: Status of the request for this recipient: 100 Processed, 101 Sent, 102 Queued, 401 RiskHold, 402 InvalidSenderId, 403 InvalidPhoneNumber, 404 UnsupportedNumberType, 405 InsufficientBalance, 406 UserInBlacklist, 407 CouldNotRoute, 409 DoNotDisturbRejection, 500 InternalServerError, 501 GatewayError, 502 RejectedByGateway.

status.description: Whether the sms was sent to this recipient or not. Docs: "This does not indicate the delivery status of the sms to this recipient."

messageId.description: The messageId received when the sms was sent — the id of its delivery report.

error_schema.description: Not documented for this endpoint, except DoNotDisturbRejection (Nigeria): HTTP 409 with the usual SMSMessageData body and a recipient statusCode 409.

gotchas: The docs now label this endpoint "Bulk (legacy)". The current one is POST /version1/messaging/bulk (send_bulk_sms, still a draft here; its page says it "also accepts json requests"), whose sandbox is "coming soon"; this endpoint has a sandbox.

username is "sandbox" in the sandbox and your application username in production. Docs (Authentication): "For POST requests in which fields are sent as a url encoded form e.g. in sending SMS, the username should be included as one of the fields within the form."

Send the body as a form. Docs (Request Headers): Content-Type "The requests content type, application/x-www-form-urlencoded"; Accept (optional) "Can be application/json or application/xml" — send Accept: application/json to get the JSON response described here.

Check SMSMessageData.Recipients[].statusCode for each recipient: 100 Processed, 101 Sent, 102 Queued; the docs list 401–502 as error codes (RiskHold, InvalidSenderId…). status "does not indicate the delivery status": the delivery comes later in webhook_delivery_report.

Nigeria (SMS Notifications page, DoNotDisturbRejection): "When attempting to send an SMS message with a promotional sender ID outside the allowed time window(8pm-8am), the API will return an HTTP 409 status code". Its example body still carries SMSMessageData, with messageId "None" and cost "0" for the rejected recipient: parse it, and do not store "None" as a message id.
Help Center (Why did my messages Fail?): "Another reason that messages may fail to be sent is if they have the (%) percentage character in the text." Strip or replace % in message.
Sandbox: a delivery report with failureReason DeliveryFailure "means that you may not be logged into the simulator, or the simulator is unreachable for some reason" (Help Center).
Hashed numbers (Safaricom, Kenya) use the same endpoint with maskedNumber and telco and an empty phoneNumbers list: that variant is documented but not modelled in this spec.
open_questions: Which countries and networks deliver the default sender AFRICASTKNG: the docs only say "defaults to AFRICASTKNG".
Which hours DoNotDisturbRejection applies to: the docs say "outside the allowed time window(8pm-8am)" without saying whether 8pm-8am is the allowed or the forbidden window.
bulkSMSMode: the docs give only the default, 1; they do not list other values or what 0 means.
